integrity: Proof and deterministic checker supplied; same-model review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: The chamber scheme encodes a finite Galois set, not the moduli of divisors or isomorphism classes of surfaces. Distinct full chamber spectra for 18 Weyl classes are certified by an exhaustive 1920-element calculation. The existence claim for each class is restricted to q>=4 under Trepalin Theorem 1.4. An implicit prior graph face cycle-index calculation remains a residual originality risk.
title: The 393 Zariski chambers of a quartic del Pezzo surface separate all eighteen Frobenius types
